statement_html:
Développer et réduire l'expression \(- 4 \left(- 2 x + 5\right)\).
.
solution_html:
\(\color{green} -4 \color{black} (\color{blue} - 2 x \color{purple}+ 5 \color{black} )\) = \(\color{green}( -4 )\color{black}\times \color{blue}( - 2 x )\) + \(\color{green}( -4 )\color{black} \times \color{purple}( 5 )\)
=\(8 x\)+\(\left(-20\right)\)
= \(8 x - 20\)
